title: One query
eyebrow: CETI · AI and energy, by the numbers · draft B (the denominator)
lede: 0.24 Wh for a median Gemini text prompt is a human-scale nothing; data centres are 1.5 % of the world's electricity, about half of US demand growth and 23 % of Ireland's. The same energy against four denominators: a query, a site, a grid, a country's own grid.

chapters.title: One query, a crowd, a site

captions: AI is using far too much energy.
AI is using almost no energy.
Both come with true numbers. Count them.
One question to a chatbot. One mark.
Google, 2025: a median text prompt takes 0.24 Wh.
A 1,000 W microwave runs 0.86 s on that.
A 60 W bulb: 14 s. A fraction of a minute.
Ask 10 a day: 2.4 Wh, 8.6 s of microwave.
Zoom out: each step is ten times the queries.
Ten times the queries, ten times the energy.
100,000 queries: 24 kWh.
A 100 MW site, 24 hours: 2.4 GWh.
100,000 marks of 100,000 queries: 10 billion.
Now the world. One mark is one TWh.
Data centres, all kinds, 2024: 415 TWh.
Against the grey, all the world's electricity: 1.5 %.
The same marks, sorted by region.
By region, the US: about 187 TWh.
China about 104. Europe about 62.
45 %, 25 %, 15 % of the world's data-centre power.
Now each country against its own grid.
Cut at Ireland, 2025: 7,663 GWh.
23 % of Ireland's metered electricity.
15 times the world's 1.5 %.
Cut at the US, 2023: 176 TWh, 4.4 % of its grid.
Yet about half of 2025's US demand growth.
Monday: for any AI energy figure, ask: per what?
One vendor's median text prompt. The anchors are assumed.

brand.takeaway: Small per query, large per grid. Divided by what?

sources: Google, Measuring the environmental impact of delivering AI at Google Scale / of AI inference (Aug 2025): median Gemini Apps text prompt 0.24 Wh. https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/infrastructure/measuring-the-environmental-impact-of-ai-inference

IEA, Energy and AI, Energy demand from AI (Apr 2025): data centres 415 TWh, about 1.5 % of world electricity in 2024; US 45 %, China 25 %, Europe 15 %. https://www.iea.org/reports/energy-and-ai/energy-demand-from-ai
IEA, Electricity 2026, executive summary and demand (2026): data centres about half of US electricity-demand growth in 2025. https://www.iea.org/reports/electricity-2026/executive-summary
Shehabi et al., 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (Dec 2024): 176 TWh, 4.4 % of US electricity in 2023.
Central Statistics Office Ireland, Data Centres Metered Electricity Consumption 2025 (7 Jul 2026): 7,663 GWh, 23 % of metered electricity.
Ember, Grids for data centres (Jun 2025): modelled data-centre shares of national demand, 2024 (Netherlands, Germany, UK, France).
EPRI, Powering Intelligence, updated U.S. data center scenarios (Feb 2026): off stage, projections.
honest: Per-query figures: one vendor's median text prompt (Google, 2025). Assumed: 1,000 W microwave, 60 W bulb, 10 prompts a day, a 100 MW site at full load.
